issues.description: Method signature mismatch for `addGuestStudents`: the problem statement/UML require `addGuestStudents(int)` but the template provides `addGuestStudents(int, boolean validateInput)`. Students following the template will implement a different public API than specified, and tests expecting the one-parameter method will fail to compile or not find the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to match the required public API: replace the stub with `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { /* TODO */ }` and remove the `boolean validateInput` parameter (any validation should be internal or via a private helper without changing the required signature).
